commands.name: brief
commands.description: Show the brief: goal, done-when, open asks, what changed, health

tools.name: brief_ask
tools.description: Queue a multiple-choice question without stopping. Put your default first; it applies if they don't answer in time.

tools.name: brief_note
tools.description: Record the goal and 2-8 done-when checks when you start (the list replaces the last; "[x] text" marks one met), tick checks with met as you finish them, or note an assumption you made.

tools.name: brief_read
tools.description: The brief as the person sees it: goal, done-when, open asks, recent answers, health. At most 8 lines.
